No subpixel details and no fine 1/2-scale pixels.

Composition: exactly one centered object, shorter and simpler than a tall battery tower.
Constraints: hard opaque shapes, no antialiasing, no gradients between logical pixels, no shadow/floor/text/logo/sparks/props, no #ff00ff in object.
Avoid: 48x48 or 64x64 detail density, tall slender silhouette, smooth rendering, tiny bevels, multiple objects.
